scope: Private Mainnet conversion recovery worker selection, without runtime provisioning or activation
sourcePath: server/index.mjs calls startApiFinancialWorkerServices without a preparedTokenConversionRuntime
server/api-financial-workers.mjs accepts only an explicitly injected prepared runtime on Mainnet and returns an inert private worker
server/token-conversion-bootstrap.mjs mints a nonserializable capability only for an actually prepared recovery-only controller
behavior: Current public API startup remains Mainnet read-only and starts no conversion recovery worker.
A manually selected recovery page rechecks finalized program context and all three role-labelled durable journals before calling the existing recovery-only controller.
The selected capability exposes tick and status only; no start, request, signer, listener or broadcast entrypoint is returned.
A missing signer journal refuses the next selected page before any further signer or send callback; a lookalike object, signing-mode runtime or Devnet context is refused.
limits: The checked runtime uses synthetic bank, RPC, finality and signer callbacks, and no production custody or network request.
The real server does not provision or inject this private capability; operational controller registration, independent custody, journal backup and live proof remain open.
Separate journal reads are not atomic across three stores; concurrent new signing can fail closed at bootstrap and requires quiescent startup or an explicitly reviewed retry.
Selection is not Mainnet financial admission, signing approval, deployment or a cap change.
